hero-arrival.alt: An original ape sits on an overflowing yellow suitcase outside a fictional Charleston art venue.

reaction-deadpan.alt: The original ape trying to act normal.

reaction-confused.alt: The original ape looking endearingly confused.

reaction-delighted.alt: The original ape with a delighted grin.

souvenir-2021-boat.alt: A fictional folded paper boat representing the first ApeFest chapter.

souvenir-2022-ticket.alt: A fictional concert ticket representing the 2022 chapter.

souvenir-2025-key.alt: A fictional hotel key tag representing Las Vegas.

souvenir-2026-print.alt: An original art print representing the Charleston chapter.

brand-logo.alt: Return to Monke logo of a smiling monkey waving from a red car.

brand-banner.alt: Return to Monke banner with a monkey driving a red car through the jungle and the $PUNCHSTER name.

meme-01-roadster.alt: An unclothed monkey grips a buckling steering wheel while a red Roadster swerves in one forest lane.

meme-02-toy.alt: A physical-looking vinyl sailor-monkey doll drives a miniature red Roadster on a collectible display base.

meme-03-evolution.alt: A continuous evolution procession leads to an instant return to a fur-covered monkey driving one Roadster.

reaction-01-excited.alt: Excited monkey drivers in sailor clothing and natural fur, side by side.

reaction-02-shocked.alt: Two shocked monkey variants squeeze visibly bent steering wheels.

reaction-03-confused.alt: Clothed and natural-fur monkey variants scratch their heads in confusion.

reaction-04-smug.alt: Two monkey drivers smirk with half-lidded, self-satisfied expressions.

reaction-05-angry.alt: Two furious monkey variants grip buckled steering wheels with clenched teeth.

reaction-06-deadpan.alt: Two monkey drivers stare ahead with flat, unimpressed expressions.
